## What changes and why

Describe the problem, proposed change, and related Issue.

## Evidence

Describe the checks or experiments performed. For experiments, include the
baseline, task/split, configuration, hardware, elapsed time, and measured result.
State anything not yet tested; link the small report and any private artifacts.

## Review

- [ ] Changes use my own branch and preserve upstream reference files.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, datasets, weights, caches, or full run outputs.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration match the result being reported.
- [ ] Repository checks pass on this PR's latest revision.
- [ ] Relevant L4/H100 evidence is linked for runtime or model-behavior changes, or the change is preparation/docs only.

Before merging, obtain one other teammate's approval and resolve review conversations.
Use squash merge. See [the CI and review guide](https://github.com/jwj1342/gemma-agent-lab/blob/main/docs/ci-and-review.md) for current enforcement status.
